neighbours.label: the word piecemeal (pie|c|emeal), and ' piece' in 'piece of mind' or an idiom
fire: The reforms have been slow and piecemeal so far.
Its charm comes from this piecemeal way of building.
Change has come piecemeal to the old town.
This cover gives homeowners real piece of mind.
The land was sold off piecemeal over many years.
The grant program gives families a piece of mind.
They adopted the new rules in a piecemeal fashion.
He released the data piecemeal over several months.
quiet: The reforms have been slow and small so far.
Its charm comes from this simple way of building.
Change has come slowly to the old town.
This cover gives homeowners real comfort at night.
The land was sold off cheaply over many years.
The grant program gives families a sense of hope.
They adopted the new rules in a careful fashion.
He released the data weekly over several months.

notes: Card: 'c' x5, ' piece' x5, ' custom' x5, ' standard' x2, 'マイ' x2, ' game' x2. Probes: 'c' in piecemeal 0.87-0.89, ' piece' in 'piece of mind' 0.469 and 'piece of cake' 0.329; 'small so far' 0.009, 'custom suit' 0.015. Near misses keep the frames without the word.
